Resolves #21338

A new example under `examples/form/validation`: a sign-up form (full name, email, password and its repeat, a terms checkbox) whose fields validate as the visitor types or leaves them. Sign up stays disabled while anything is invalid, a list beside the button names the current problems of the fields the visitor has engaged with, and a valid sign-up shows the submitted values with the password masked. The portal catalog gains the record (its cover is still to be captured, so the card does not publish yet), and `seo.json` gains the example's route.

Evidence: L1 (unit and e2e specs added for CI; the seo route output was verified against the repo's own generator locally) → L2 required (AC-4: frames at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 in both themes; AC-5: frames on this PR). Residual: AC-4 frames, AC-5 frames, Residual-Owner: #21329. The frames are not attached yet: the preparation sandbox could not render the themed app (its headless browser never loaded the framework CSS), so the frames will be attached in a follow-up comment as soon as they are produced.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/form/ValidationExample.spec.mjs` (a bad email shows its error while typing) and `test/playwright/unit/examples/form/validation/MainContainer.spec.mjs` |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same specs (the button stays disabled while a field is invalid; the list names the email error, the password mismatch and the unchecked terms box) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the unit spec (sign-up shows the submitted values, password masked) and the e2e spec (the result panel after clicking Sign up) |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: frames at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 in both themes will be attached in a follow-up comment (not yet produced, see the Evidence note); the e2e spec drives the form at both sizes in CI |
| AC-5 | The record ships in this PR (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, id `form-validation`, caption naming the question); frames at both sizes to follow with AC-4 |

## Deltas from ticket
- The problem list names the errors of the fields the visitor has engaged with (typed in, left, or a submit attempt), mirroring when each field shows its own error. A field the visitor has not reached yet stays quiet, instead of the form opening with five problems before the first keystroke.
- The submitted-values display masks the password and shows its length only: a receipt is not a place to print a secret back.

## Test Evidence
Local, outside CI: `node --check` passes on both new modules and both new specs. The repo's own seo generator (`formatStandaloneExampleSeo` over `collectExampleRoutes`) produces exactly the title and description committed to `seo.json` for `/examples/form/validation/index.html`, and all 160 collected route names and titles stay unique with the new route. `check-examples-body-only`, `check-file-sizes`, `check-class-module-scope` and `check-theme-surfaces` all pass. The Playwright unit specs run locally in Node (unit-engine project): the portal catalog spec passes 40 of 40 and the new example spec passes 5 of 5. The Playwright e2e suite itself runs in CI: the preparation sandbox has no browser binary, so no local e2e receipt exists.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The Forms & Fields group page lists the example once its cover is captured
- [ ] Frames at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, in both themes, checked on the released Portal

Authored by @daichunghy (Muse Spark 1.3, reasoning: default, Muse)

**Early read.** These would otherwise be the review's required actions:

- **AC-2: a blocked Sign up has to say why.** Measured headless on your head: I filled the name, the email and both passwords validly and left the terms box untouched. Sign up stays disabled, and the list says *"Nothing wrong with what you have filled in so far."* Nothing tells the visitor what blocks them. The click path that validates every field can't run while the form is invalid, because the button is disabled; the `onSignUpClick` docblock describes that path. There are two ways to fix it. AC-4's keyboard part has no test yet; a Tab / Space / Enter pass in the e2e spec would cover it.
- **The record's name.** `form.Validation` is a class name, and #21140 design 7 asks for a title that says what the example shows. "Sign-up validation" would do.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: Non-blocking edge case verified against `src/form/field/Text.mjs:971-994,1449-1453`: `MainContainer` subscribes to `FormContainer`'s `fieldChange` (`MainContainer.mjs:78,173-176`), so tabbing into and out of an empty required field before typing any character shows that field's own blur validation state without adding to `engagedFields` until the first `fieldChange` fires (matching the PR's documented `## Deltas from ticket` quiet-initial-list choice). Also verified that `Text#isValid()` runs `this.validate(true)` (`error` preserved when `externalError` / `error_` is set after `afterSetValue`) and returns `this.error ? false : super.isValid()`, so `syncPasswordMatch()` setting `repeat.error = me.passwordMismatchText` right before `form.isValid()` keeps `Sign up` disabled reliably.
